mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sgtransit_abuse_limit WHERE reset_at < TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sgtransit_abuse_limit (bucket_key, hits, reset_at) VALUES (#{key}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bucket_key = bucket_key
mapper.update: UPDATE sgtransit_abuse_limit SET hits = CASE WHEN reset_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE hits + 1 END, reset_at = CASE WHEN reset_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{seconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE reset_at END WHERE bucket_key = #{key} AND (reset_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP OR hits < #{limit})
